The agent answers from your documents. It does not use the internet.

Your procedures, contracts, price sheets, and past work have most of the answers that your team needs. But these documents are in many drives and inboxes. We build an agent that answers from your files and shows the source, so people can check it.

How your team finds answers today

  • Ask the one who knows Staff ask the same person the same questions all day.
  • Search five places Staff search drives, inboxes, wikis, and old tickets, one at a time.
  • Old copies There are three versions of the procedure. Nobody knows which one is current.
  • Lost knowledge When a person leaves, their knowledge goes with them.

What we build

We build in accounts that you control. The agent prepares the work. A person approves each decision.

  1. Your documents, indexed The agent indexes your procedures, contracts, price sheets, and past work. The documents stay where they are, in your account.
  2. Answers with sources Each answer links to the document and passage that it came from, so anyone can check it.
  3. Access that you control Each person gets answers only from documents that they can see. We set up providers so that they do not train models on your documents.

Tell us about your task

How it starts

  1. 01 A call about one task Tell us about one task that takes a lot of your time. Tell us which tools it uses. We tell you if we should build it.
  2. 02 Build it in your accounts We set up the data and connectors in accounts that you control. We start with the tools for that task.
  3. 03 Run it with a person in charge The agent writes drafts, does checks, and flags problems. A person on your team approves each important action.
  4. 04 You get the system We give you the code, the documentation, and the access. You can keep us for support, but you do not have to.

You stay in control

You own it
Your data, code, and credentials stay in accounts that you control.
You can leave
We use open formats and write documentation. Another team can take over and not build the system again.
You can see what agents did
The system records each agent action. The record shows what the agent read, what it proposed, and who approved it.
You choose the AI
The system does not depend on one model provider. You decide which models can read which data.
